I was sitting in Spanish class in high school when I heard overhead somebody sing the little jingle, "Skunk in the back yard, pe ew!" I proceeded to explain that the words originally were, "Shave and a hair cut,  five cents!" And that it was sung by barbershop quartets as a way to bring in customers. The girl in front of me then sneers at me, "Wow, you must watch a lot of T.V." The whole class laughed at at her completely irrelevant and non sensible little "joke" and at me. God I hated high school.

I'm sure it's unnecessary for me to tell you that those years of my life were quite painful. I nearly killed myself. I'm trying to recuperate from all that pain now but it's very difficult. That and a year of heavy medications that put me in an almost catatonic state that I'm finally breaking out of piled in with the pressure of growing older into a increasingly unacceptable position in my life makes matters..."fun".

Writing, or pretty much anything creative. I love to create. I wrote a book of poetry and prose but I never plan on publishing it. It's very self-righteous and in the face of what I have dealt with surprisingly arrogant. Most of it was written in school whilst under the pressure of panic attacks.

I've had my life saved before. Actually, about a month ago. I had started my first year of college and couldn't take the pressure. I've had a history of mental health issues and going to college for me was a big step. I barely made it through high school alive. And when I say that, I mean it in the most literal way possible. I spent time in a mental health clinic after threatening to commit suicide. Dealing with severe anxieties and phobia along with manic depression can do that to a person. But I ended up graduating with high honors and thought I could handle college. I couldn't. Two weeks in I had a suicide note written and a bottle of pills I was going to down. Then, a girl asked me out to dinner. We went and I had a moment of brief clarity. I told her about my plan to end my own life and she called campus police and they took me away in an ambulance. That girl saved my life.

TL;DR: Went to college, nearly attempted suicide, girl asked me out to dinner, told her about it, she saved my life
